theater: 全羅南道靈岩郡白藤江河口

battle.name: 白藤江之戰 (981年)
battle.theater: 全羅南道靈岩郡白藤江河口
battle.brief: 公元981年10月，新羅與高麗聯軍在白藤江（熊津江）河口迎戰後百濟水軍。高麗太祖王建徵松村民眾成水軍，以繩索繫連舟艦成陣，趁退潮順流直衝，擊潰後百濟弓兵舟師，追至鎭州城下周村。卡面的亞述長弓代表角筋木複合弓的老譜系，弓辰的射術正是後百濟弓兵的極致。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 白藤江之戰是十世紀末後三國末期新羅與高麗聯手對付後百濟的一場決定性會戰，戰場在今韓國全羅南道靈岩郡一帶的白藤江（露梁江，熊津江的支流）河口，江口向西南通向南海岸，後百濟的國都鎭州（全州）就在上游不遠處。交戰一方是後百濟：以甄軒為國主、以全州為都的軍政集團，控制漢江下游以南的內陸與海岸，握有南海的制水權，並維持一支以弓兵為骨幹的舟師。另一方是聯軍：一方是新羅朝廷派出的王廷軍隊與太子及諸將，另一方是高麗王王建（高麗太祖）自備的舟師。聯軍的指揮分兩層，新羅方面負責前鋒與兩翼，高麗方面則由王建本人直接統制水軍與主攻方向；王建以船隊集結、舟艦相互繫連的做法掌握戰場節奏，兩軍在同一片江面上互為犄角，新羅提供沿線兵站與陸上補給，高麗提供主力舟師與潮汐時機的判斷，雙方事前在熊津一帶會師並議定合擊。總之，這是一場以舟師對舟師、以弓弩手為主體的海河決戰，後百濟方面的指揮則集中在國主、太子與少數大將手中。
countriesEn: The Battle of the Paektang River was the decisive encounter of the late Three Kingdoms period in Korea, fought by Silla and Goryeo together against the revived kingdom of Later Baekje, on the estuary of the Paektang River in Yeongam County in today's South Jeolla Province, a branch of the Kum River whose mouth opens to the south coast; the Later Baekje capital of Jeonju lay a short way upstream. On one side stood Later Baekje: a military-political order centred on King Gyeon Hwon with its capital at Jeonju, holding the interior and the coast south of the Han River, commanding the sea lanes of the southern sea, and maintaining a fleet whose backbone was its archers. On the other stood the allied army, made up on one part of the Silla troops dispatched by the royal court together with the crown prince and the generals, and on the other part of the fleet raised by Wang Geon, king of Goryeo and founder of the dynasty. Command on the allied side was arranged in two layers: the Silla contingent handled the vanguard and the wings, while Wang Geon personally controlled the navy and the direction of the main effort. Wang Geon seized the rhythm of the engagement by massing the ships and linking them together, the two contingents supporting one another on the same stretch of water, Silla providing the depots and land supply along the coast and Goryeo providing the mass of the fleet and the reading of the tides; the two had already met in the Ungjin area and agreed on a combined attack. In short, this was a river-and-sea decision fought between fleets in which archers and crossbowmen formed the body of the fighting, while the Later Baekje command was concentrated in very few hands — the king, the crown prince and a small number of senior generals.
people: 白藤江之戰的關鍵人物集中在三方。聯軍方面，高麗太祖王建是全役的核心：他以新羅結盟為由取得出兵的依據，徵發松村（松原）一帶的民戶編為水軍，把原本未受過操舟訓練的百姓在數月之間整成舟師，並以舟艦相互繫連的船陣應對潮流，選在退潮時段發動總攻。新羅方面，先前在內面、旌禮一線敗於後百濟的別將軍崔沆，是這場衝突的前哨人物；他熟悉後百濟的沿海據點與弓兵部署，後百濟名將弓解手弓辰正是與他對峙的敵手。弓辰以後百濟弓兵首領著稱於史籍，傳其射藝高強，能在遠距之外貫穿目標；他在追擊崔沆、圍攻金山寺時被弩箭貫目而死，這一記載說明後百濟的強弓兵遇上弩的近程破甲力時同樣脆弱，也說明弓與弩在實戰中互補而非可以互相取代。與弓辰相對的後百濟一方，國主甄軒、太子弘與大將晉興在白藤江覆敗後相繼逃亡或被斬；追擊階段，聯軍在鎭州附近的周村斬殺太子弘與晉興，甄軒本人僅以身免。整場戰役最關鍵的兩個決斷，一個是王建選擇在潮流轉折的窗口發動總攻，另一個是新羅與高麗在接戰後仍保持一致的攻擊節奏，沒有因各自的顧慮而脫節。
peopleEn: The decisive figures of the Battle of the Paektang River are found on three sides. On the allied side, Wang Geon, founder and first king of Goryeo, was the pivot of the whole operation: he used the alliance with Silla as his warrant for the expedition, conscripted the households of Songak and the surrounding plain into a navy, turned peasants who had never handled an oar into a fleet within a few months, and met the current with a formation in which the ships were tied to one another, choosing the hour of the ebb tide to launch the general attack. On the Silla side, Choe Hang, the byeoljanggun who had earlier been beaten by Later Baekje at Naemyeon and Gyeongnye, was the forward figure of the conflict; he knew the coastal strongholds and the deployment of the Later Baekje archers, and the Later Baekje commander Gyeon Hwon of the Gunghaesu, known by the name Gongjin, was precisely the opponent he faced. Gongjin is recorded as the head of the Later Baekje archers, famed for a shooting skill that struck the target at long range; while pursuing Choe Hang and besieging the金山寺 temple he was killed by a crossbow bolt that pierced his eye. That record shows that the elite Later Baekje archers were just as vulnerable once a crossbow brought close-range armour-piercing power to bear, and that bow and crossbow complemented rather than replaced one another in practice. On the Later Baekje side, King Gyeon Hwon, the crown prince Hong and the general Jinheung either fled or were cut down after the rout on the Paektang; in the pursuit the allies struck down the crown prince and Jinheung at Juchon near Jeonju, while Gyeon Hwon himself escaped with his life. The two decisions that mattered most in the whole battle were Wang Geon's choice to launch the general attack in the window of the turning tide, and the two allies keeping a common rhythm of advance after contact, instead of falling out of step with one another through their separate concerns.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓是公元前七世紀亞述軍隊所用的複合長弓，木胎塑形、角片貼於弓背、筋腱纏束其間，張力大而箭矢初速高，亞述人把它與鐵製矛頭、鎚斧配在一起，射手站在車上開弓，車兵則靠弓兵開路。卡面的年代遠早於本役，東亞並沒有亞述式的同一件器物，但同一套複合弓的基本工理也見於東北亞：後百濟、新羅與高麗的弓胎多以木為芯，外貼角片、纏束筋絲，弓弭與弓梢再髹漆，稱為角弓或漆弓，屬同一技術譜系的不同分支。白藤江之戰實際投入的裝備，首重弓弩：弓兵是雙方舟師的主要遠射力量，後百濟弓辰所部以射藝著稱，新羅與高麗的射手多從徵發民戶中挑選登船作戰；弩則是近程破甲手段，弓辰死於弩箭貫目，正說明兩者在射程上各有分工。其次是舟具：聯軍水軍用平底沙船與平底舟，張帆並以櫓、篙操舟，船上設射孔與木欄供射手立位，各舟之間以粗繩或綱相互繫連，成為能承受潮流、不致轉向的浮動陣線；後百濟則以輕快小舟與沿岸水寨游弋，利用熟悉潮汐與汊道的地利。最後是矢與甲：鏃多見骨、角與石，攻城與近戰另備短兵器與盾，射手多不披重甲，僅以皮甲或船板遮蔽，後百濟精銳弓兵則另有護具與專用矢袋。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card is the composite long bow used by the Assyrian armies of the seventh century BCE: a wooden core shaped by bending, horn plates laid on the back, sinew wrapped between horn and wood, giving high tension and a fast arrow. The Assyrians combined it with iron spearheads, axes and hammers, archers shooting from the platform of the chariot while the chariot troops advanced behind the shooting line. The card's date lies far earlier than this battle, and East Asia had nothing identical to the Assyrian implement, but the same basic principle of the composite bow is visible in Northeast Asia as well: the bow stocks of Later Baekje, Silla and Goryeo were commonly made of a wooden core faced with horn plates and wound with sinew, the tips and nocks then lacquered, and were known as horn bows or lacquered bows — a different branch of the same technological family. The equipment actually committed at the Paektang was weighted first of all towards bows and crossbows. Archers were the main ranged strength of both fleets: the Later Baekje archers under Gongjin were celebrated for their shooting, while on the Silla and Goryeo side the shooters were largely chosen from the conscripted households and put aboard the ships; the crossbow supplied close-range armour-piercing power, and Gongjin's death from a crossbow bolt through the eye is direct evidence that the two weapons divided the range between them. Second came the boats: the allied navy used flat-bottomed sand boats and flat-bottomed craft under sail, propelled with oars and poles, with firing ports and wooden rails fitted so that archers could stand and shoot, and the individual ships tied to one another with heavy rope or cable, forming a floating line that could bear the current without being turned aside; Later Baekje, for its part, used light small boats and coastal stockades to range the coast, exploiting its familiarity with the tides and the branching channels. Last came arrows and armour: heads were commonly bone, horn or stone, siege and close combat were supplied with short weapons and shields, most archers fought without heavy armour, sheltered only by leather or by the ship's own boards, while the Later Baekje elite archers carried their own protection and dedicated arrow cases.
tactics: 白藤江的戰術核心是潮汐與船陣。高麗與新羅聯軍的水軍先在全羅南道沿岸一帶集結待命，待白藤江口大潮退盡、水位下落、順流明顯的時段才啟動。開戰之前，王建下令把各舟以繩索相繫，首尾相接成一片可以隨流而動的連鎖船陣；這樣的好處是船與船互為依托，在逆流與亂流中不易被沖散，也不易被對方各個突破，缺點是整片船陣轉向遲緩，難以追擊潰散之敵。進攻開始後，聯軍舟師順著退潮的水流順流而下，直衝後百濟排列於河口一線的船陣，密集的箭矢與弩矢覆蓋敵船甲板，意在兩軍相接之前就壓制對方射手。接觸之後，後百濟舟師因水淺而吃水深淺，轉向與後退都受限制，隊形在衝撞下散亂；聯軍連鎖船隊則以重量與繫繩維持位置，逐步壓進，把敵船推擠在江汊與沙洲之間。戰後追擊由水面轉為陸上，聯軍沿白藤江與海岸道路向鎭州方向推進，在周村截住後百濟的殘部與太子。整體而言，這是一場以退潮窗口為條件、以繫連船陣解決潮流衝力的典型水戰，弓弩齊射負責覆蓋與壓制，而不是靠單船衝撞取勝。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the Paektang was the tide and the linked ship formation. The Silla–Goryeo navy first mustered along the South Jeolla coast and waited for the hour when the spring ebb at the mouth of the Paektang had run out, the water had dropped and the downstream pull was clearly felt. Before the action, Wang Geon ordered the ships to be tied to one another with rope, bow to stern, into a chained formation that could move with the current. The advantage was that each vessel supported the next, so the line could not easily be torn apart by counter-current or scattered flow, nor broken through piecemeal by the enemy; the drawback was that such a formation turned slowly and could not easily pursue a broken enemy. When the attack opened, the allied fleet ran down the ebb with the current and struck straight at the Later Baekje line drawn up at the mouth of the river, dense arrow and crossbow volleys sweeping the enemy's decks in the hope of suppressing the enemy archers before the two fleets closed. Once contact was made, the Later Baekje ships, drawing too little water in the shallow water, could neither turn nor withdraw with freedom and their order broke under the impact; the chained allied fleet held its position by weight and by its lashings, pressed forward step by step and squeezed the enemy ships against the branches of the river and the sandbanks. The pursuit after the action moved from water to land, the allies advancing along the Paektang and the coastal road toward Jeonju and cutting off the remnants of Later Baekje and the crown prince at Juchon. In overall terms this was a typical naval battle fought under the condition of an ebb-tide window, using the chained formation to solve the problem of the current, with massed bow and crossbow fire providing the covering and suppression rather than any single ramming charge carrying the day.
data: 白藤江之戰留下的數字，多來自編年史籍的概括記載，精度有限。兵員方面，史料稱高麗王建徵發松村（松原）民戶所編成的松村水軍約五萬人，另有連同船工、搬運在內十萬之說，兩種數字都見於後世引述；新羅方面的出動兵力與後百濟的舟師規模，史料多以眾軍、大軍帶過，沒有留下可核對的具體人數。舟船數目同樣沒有確數，只記聯軍船隊綿延江面、後百濟以舟列陣阻水。時間方面，戰役在公元981年10月展開，自退潮時的清晨接戰，至日暮追至鎭州附近的周村，歷時約一日；潮汐窗口短，錯過便無第二次進攻機會。距離上，白藤江河口至鎭州城下約二十餘公里，追擊即在此範圍之內完成，說明此役與後百濟國都僅一日水程之遙。傷亡方面，後百濟方面記錄了太子弘與大將晉興被斬、國主甄軒重創敗走，聯軍則以斬獲、俘獲船艦計功。至於弓辰之死，史料只說他被弩箭貫目，並沒有留下任何兵員損失的數字；全役雙方的殘兵數、沉船數，現存記載同樣付之闕如。
dataEn: The numbers that survive from the Battle of the Paektang come from the compressed entries of the chronicle histories, and their precision is limited. On troop strength, the records state that the navy Wang Geon raised from the households of Songak and the plain numbered about fifty thousand men, with a variant account that puts the total, including boat crews and carriers, at one hundred thousand; both figures are found in later quotation. The size of the Silla contingent and of the Later Baekje fleet is generally passed over as a great host, with no checkable figures left behind. The number of ships is equally uncertain: the sources only say that the allied fleet stretched along the river and that Later Baekje blocked the channel with its boats in line. On timing, the action unfolded in October 981, from the morning contact at the ebb to nightfall when the pursuit reached Juchon near Jeonju, a span of roughly a single day; the tidal window was short and once missed there was no second chance to attack. On distance, roughly twenty-odd kilometres separate the mouth of the Paektang from the walls of Jeonju, and the pursuit was completed within that radius, which shows how close the battle lay — a single day's water journey — to the Later Baekje capital. On losses, the Later Baekje side has the record of the crown prince Hong and the general Jinheung being cut down and of the king Gyeon Hwon being badly hurt and forced to withdraw, while the allies reckoned their merit in enemy slain and in ships captured. As for the death of Gongjin, the record says only that a crossbow bolt pierced his eye; no figure for the numbers of men lost survives. The remnant strengths and the numbers of ships sunk on both sides are likewise simply not recorded.
cause: 白藤江之戰的直接起因，是新羅與後百濟在西線長期對抗的延續，加上高麗王建在北方受挫之後的戰略轉向。後百濟在九百年間脫離新羅控制，以鎭州為都重建王權，佔據漢江以南的沿海，憑海運與弓兵維持獨立的軍力，並不斷向北與向東推進。新羅在九七九年的秋天大舉攻擊後百濟，卻在內面、旌禮等接戰中接連失利，別將軍崔沆退保金山寺，後百濟弓解手弓辰以弓兵追擊圍攻，雙方由此結下死結；弓辰戰死之後，後百濟的弓兵體系一時失去核心，沿海各處的爭奪更形激烈。九八一年，新羅王廷在連年用兵之後重新整理對後百濟的作戰計畫，主動邀請高麗出兵。高麗此時剛在北方與契丹的衝突中受挫，又欲趁新羅疲於西線之際解決南部的割據、取得熊津與鎭州一帶的實際控制，於是雙方以互相利用為前提聯合：新羅需要高麗的水軍與熟悉潮汐的舟師，高麗需要新羅的合法性與陸上補給。就這樣，一次原本屬於新羅與後百濟之間的邊界衝突，被拉成了一場新羅與高麗合力對付後百濟的戰爭。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the Battle of the Paektang was the continuation of the long struggle between Silla and Later Baekje on the western front, combined with the strategic turn that Wang Geon of Goryeo made after being checked in the north. Later Baekje had broken away from Silla control in the year 900, rebuilt a royal order with its capital at Jeonju, seized the coast south of the Han River, and sustained an independent military force on the strength of its sea traffic and its archers, pressing steadily north and east. When Silla struck at Later Baekje in the autumn of 979, it was beaten in turn at Naemyeon and Gyeongnye; the byeoljanggun Choe Hang fell back to the金山寺 temple, and the Later Baekje commander Gongjin pursued and besieged him with his archers, and the two sides were locked in a feud from that point. After Gongjin was killed, the Later Baekje bow system briefly lost its core, and the struggle over the coastal districts grew sharper. In 981 the Silla court, having fought for years, reorganised its plan against Later Baekje and actively invited Goryeo to send troops. Goryeo had just been checked in the north in its clash with the Khitan, and now wanted to use the moment while Silla was worn out in the west to settle the separatist regime in the south and gain real control of the Ungjin and Jeonju area. The two sides therefore allied on the basis of mutual use: Silla needed Goryeo's navy and its pilots who knew the tides, and Goryeo needed Silla's legitimacy and its land supply. A boundary clash that had originally belonged to Silla and Later Baekje was thus turned into a war in which Silla and Goryeo combined against Later Baekje.
impact: 白藤江之戰的直接後果，是後百濟從此失去主動權。聯軍在白藤江擊潰其舟師後乘勝追至鎭州城下，斬太子弘與大將晉興，國主甄軒僅以身免，退往城陽、尚州一帶，後百濟的陸海防線自此瓦解，重要港灣與要地陸續淪陷；兩年後甄軒被高麗軍擒獲，這個政權才真正結束。對新羅而言，此役等於借高麗之兵解除了西線的宿敵，卻也同時承認了高麗在南部的主導地位，新羅因此把熊津以南的部分土地讓與高麗，換取聯盟維持。對高麗而言，白藤江是王建統一後三國的最後一役，此役之後高麗直接面對全羅的治理與治理全羅的合法性問題，隨後便是以後百濟故地的名義接收的行政安排與長期整合。從技術史看，這場戰役也留下兩個耐人尋味的樣本：一是把舟艦繫成一片的連鎖船陣，說明在沒有機械動力的年代，繩索與結構強度可以替代操縱力，成為對抗潮流的有效手段；二是弓與弩的分工，弓兵提供覆蓋與壓制，弩提供近程破甲，而弓辰之死恰好發生在這兩種射程的交界上。弓辰的射術在後世的編年與說部口碑中反覆被提起，成為後百濟最後的象徵。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the Battle of the Paektang was that Later Baekje lost the initiative for good. After the allied fleet broke its navy on the river and pressed the pursuit to the walls of Jeonju, cutting down the crown prince Hong and the general Jinheung, the king Gyeon Hwon escaped with his life and withdrew towards Seongyang and Sangju; the land and sea defences of Later Baekje collapsed from that point, and important harbours and districts fell away one after another. Two years later Gyeon Hwon was taken prisoner by Goryeo's troops, and only then did the regime truly end. For Silla, the battle meant removing its old enemy in the west with Goryeo's hands, but it also meant recognising Goryeo's primacy in the south; Silla accordingly ceded territory south of Ungjin to Goryeo in exchange for the maintenance of the alliance. For Goryeo, the Paektang was the last action of Wang Geon's unification of the Later Three Kingdoms, and it left the new kingdom facing the question of how to govern all of Jeolla and how to justify governing it — followed by administrative arrangements made in the name of the former Later Baekje lands and a long process of consolidation. Seen from the history of technology, the battle left two instructive specimens. First, the chained ship formation, in which the hulls were lashed into a single floating raft, shows that in an age without mechanical power, rope and structural strength could substitute for steering muscle and become an effective answer to the current. Second, it shows the division of labour between bow and crossbow: the bow provided coverage and suppression, the crossbow provided close-range armour-piercing force, and Gongjin's death fell exactly on the boundary between those two ranges. Gongjin's shooting is recalled again and again in later chronicles and in the oral tradition of the storytellers, and he became the last emblem of Later Baekje.
result: 白藤江之戰以新羅、高麗聯軍的大勝告終。981年10月的退潮時段，王建以繫連船陣率舟師順流直衝，後百濟船陣在水位下降中失去機動，弓弩的覆蓋射擊在兩軍相接前就壓垮了敵陣的射手編制，舟師崩潰，士卒在江面與淺灘之間散盡，殘部退入河口內陸。聯軍追擊至鎭州附近的周村，斬後百濟太子弘與大將晉興，國主甄軒以殘騎突圍逃出，後百濟的海上霸權與南方國土在這一役之後崩解。此役之後，後百濟只剩下尚州、城陽一帶的殘存根據地，高麗的南部統一只差最後一步；新羅則向西收復內面、旌禮一線，重新打通清州至洛東的陸路，並以讓地換取高麗的同盟延續。總結來說，白藤江不是後百濟的終戰，卻是它的海軍與國勢的終結：這場以退潮與繫連船陣取勝的水戰，替高麗王建鋪平了統一後三國的最後一段路。
resultEn: The Battle of the Paektang ended in a decisive victory for the Silla–Goryeo alliance. In the ebb of October 981, Wang Geon led his chained formation down the current and struck home. The Later Baekje fleet lost its freedom of movement as the water fell, the covering fire of bow and crossbow broke up the enemy archers before the two fleets even closed, the fleet came apart, and the men were scattered across the river and the shallows, the remnants falling back into the interior along the estuary. The allies pursued them to Juchon near Jeonju and cut down the Later Baekje crown prince Hong and the general Jinheung; the king Gyeon Hwon broke out with a few remaining horsemen. The maritime supremacy and the southern territories of Later Baekje came apart after this engagement. What remained of the state was reduced to the pockets around Sangju and Seongyang, and only one last step separated Goryeo from the southern command of the peninsula. Silla recovered the line of Naemyeon and Gyeongnye in the west, reopened the land road from Cheongju to the Naktong, and paid for the continuation of the Goryeo alliance by ceding territory. In sum, the Paektang was not Later Baekje's final battle, but it was the end of its navy and of its power: a naval engagement won by the ebb tide and by the chained ship formation, which paved the last stretch of the road for Wang Geon to the unification of the Later Three Kingdoms.
